name: syn_admissions_accept
prediction_point: Offer decision date (features are those known at application).
target_definition: target_accept = 1 if the offer was accepted (decision ADMITTED); 0 if declined (ADMITTED_DECLINED).

excluded_leakage_columns.decision_date: date of the decision (after the prediction point)
excluded_leakage_columns.student_id: exists only for applicants who enrolled (reveals the outcome)

population: Applications that received an offer, entry terms 2016FA-2026FA.
split: Chronological by entry term: test = entry terms of academic year 2025/26 onwards (2025FA, 2026SP, 2026SU, 2026FA); train = earlier entry terms; test-period applicants removed from training.
notes: Acceptance -> enrolment conversion is 100 % in every historical term of the synthetic data (every accepted offer enrolled), so no acceptance-to-enrolment model is trained (no variation to learn).
